_comment: What it costs an Age's instability budget to open tears in its ground, and how far that goes
(design 5.0, 5.1). Dearer than a torn seam: a seam is the world's shape being wrong, a wound is the
world being holed. Each step bought makes one likelier per chunk rather than adding a fixed count --
a handful of wounds in a whole dimension is a handful nobody ever walks past.
